sentences.text: Mrs. Vandana Singh, the learned counsel appearing for the respondent State submits that supplementary counter affidavit dated 22.8.2022 has been filed in which all the relevant annexures of sanction and prosecution have been brought on record.

In view of these development, this petition is disposed of with direction to the petitioner to approach the concerned learned court by way of making appropriate prayer for release of the articles in question.
Since the articles are perishable, the learned court shall decide the said petition expeditiously.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) SI/
